chunks: And the followers will say: 'If only we had a second chance, we would disown them as they disowned us.' Thus God will show them their deeds, filling them with remorse; and they shall not exit the Fire.

key_terms.يَتَبَرَّأُونَ: to disown / to declare innocence from

ai.seo_question: What will the followers say in Hell regarding their leaders?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological torment of the 'followers' (attabi') who realize their blind obedience led to ruin, emphasizing that divine justice reveals the true weight of their deeds. The mutual disownment underscores the severance of spiritual bonds in the Hereafter, serving as a warning against following leaders without independent verification of their truthfulness. This scene illustrates the finality of regret, where the opportunity for repentance has passed, and the Fire becomes their permanent abode.
